import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class ModInt {
        static final long MD = 1000000007L;
        long v;

        public ModInt() {
            this.v = 0;
        }

        public ModInt(long _v) {
            setV(_v % MD);
        }

        public ModInt setV(long _v) {
            v = _v >= 0 ? _v : _v + MD;
            if (v >= MD) v -= MD;
            return this;
        }

        public boolean isZero() {
            return v == 0;
        }

        public ModInt negate() {
            return new ModInt().setV(MD - v);
        }

        public ModInt add(ModInt r) {
            return new ModInt().setV(v + r.v);
        }

        public ModInt subtract(ModInt r) {
            return new ModInt().setV(v + MD - r.v);
        }

        public ModInt multiply(ModInt r) {
            return new ModInt().setV((v * r.v) % MD);
        }

        public ModInt divide(ModInt r) {
            return this.multiply(r.inv());
        }

        public ModInt pow(long n) {
            ModInt x = new ModInt(v);
            ModInt r = new ModInt(1);
            while (n > 0) {
                if ((n & 1) == 1) r = r.multiply(x);
                x = x.multiply(x);
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return r;
        }

        public ModInt inv() {
            return pow(MD - 2);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(v);
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        List<Integer> first;
        ModInt second;

        public Pair(List<Integer> first, ModInt second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer stz = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(stz.nextToken());

        ModInt[][] mat = new ModInt[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            stz = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int x = Integer.parseInt(stz.nextToken());
                mat[i][j] = new ModInt(x).divide(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<Pair> sts = new ArrayList<>();
        sts.add(new Pair(new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(0)), new ModInt(1)));

        for (int ph = 0; ph < n; ph++) {
            List<Pair> nsts = new ArrayList<>();
            int limit = 1 << n;
            for (int f = 1; f < limit; f++) {
                ModInt freq = new ModInt(1);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (((f >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                        freq = freq.multiply(mat[ph][i]);
                    } else {
                        freq = freq.multiply(new ModInt(1).subtract(mat[ph][i]));
                    }
                }
                for (Pair st : sts) {
                    List<Integer> nst = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int d : st.first) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                            if (((d >> i) & 1) == 1) continue;
                            if (((f >> i) & 1) == 0) continue;
                            int newD = d ^ (1 << i);
                            nst.add(newD);
                        }
                    }
                    if (nst.isEmpty()) continue;
                    Collections.sort(nst);
                    nst = new ArrayList<>(new LinkedHashSet<>(nst));
                    nsts.add(new Pair(nst, st.second.multiply(freq)));
                }
            }
            nsts.sort(Comparator.comparing(p -> p.first));
            List<Pair> newSts = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Pair st : nsts) {
                if (!newSts.isEmpty() && newSts.get(newSts.size() - 1).first.equals(st.first)) {
                    newSts.get(newSts.size() - 1).second = newSts.get(newSts.size() - 1).second.add(st.second);
                } else {
                    newSts.add(st);
                }
            }
            sts = newSts;
        }

        ModInt ans = sts.isEmpty() ? new ModInt(0) : sts.get(0).second;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
